lines.t: When I look in your eyes, I see all of time
In one glimpse I fall apart Pure love, no end
Mercy in your face You hold every moment
In your hands And my heart can't hold it
When I look in your eyes
No shadow can hide me, no lie can stay
Your fire is holy, and it makes a way
And my heart can't hold it, all the weight of glory
I'm undone before you, still you call me near
When I look in your eyes, I see forever
And by Yahushua, your justice is so good
Pure love has no end, pure love has no end
You reign in mercy, you reign in truth
Truth, every tear you gather, every wrong you heal
Yeah, who's you? Yeah, who's you?
When I look in your eyes, I see forever
